interpretation: CUDA and bounded restart checks passed; this does not certify every training path.
The model fits all 128 training examples but only 68 unseen-entity and 65 changed-template examples out of 128. The two-label diagnostic exposes weak transfer; it does not establish the sole cause.
Low LR is least damaging in this short screen. Its 0.0044 CE improvement is small; higher LR alone does not fix the model. This is not a long-run optimal-LR search.
Same baseline and data across arms verified. Fresh 64-document validation differs from previous 256-document suite; do not compare their absolute CE.
All 96 endpoint completions reviewed. No conversation/tool acceptance was run or passed; none of these branches is promoted.

recommended_next_experiment.decision: Keep 124M architecture and 6e-5 control; test training distribution before enlarging model or launching long pretraining.
recommended_next_experiment.design: Sequential equal-token branches from the protected parent: existing admitted broad-text control versus a quality-audited coherent-text mixture with diverse counterfactual entity-binding examples. Keep tokenizer, optimizer, batch and evaluation constant.
data_requirements: Deduplicate and filter incoherent/repetitive documents; preserve provenance and license admission.
Vary entity forms, labels, query position, distractors and paraphrases; split by entity and template family, not random rows.
Add a template-only holdout using known entities to distinguish template shift from combined entity/template shift.
Evaluate independent contextual probes and raw generations; reserve private acceptance for a selected candidate.
recommended_next_experiment.proposed_budget: 10M targets per branch (20M total), one A100, maximum one-hour lease after data and cost preflight; proposed only, not started.
recommended_next_experiment.gate: Require improved held-out language and meaningful context transfer without repetitive collapse before investing in longer pretraining; subsequently validate conversation SFT and executable tool traces separately.
recommended_next_experiment.limits: No guarantee that 20M more tokens produces a useful assistant. A larger model and repetition penalties do not address the demonstrated transfer failure by themselves.

backup_policy: GCS training inputs, exact code bundle, pinned image identity, environment, checkpoints with SHA receipts, reports and server logs. 30-day lifecycle.
